verdict.rationale: HumanLayer docs explicitly describe `humanlayer automation run` for running a Cloud-visible coding session 'from any automation environment — a CI job, a cron machine, or a script on a server,' plus launch tokens for non-interactive command execution, directly supporting CI/CD-triggered agent runs. However, there is no explicit example or integration guide showing a CI failure (broken build/failing test) triggering the agent to diagnose and fix it, nor independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow. missing for 10: a concrete CI/CD pipeline example tied to build/test failures, evidence of automatic failure detection triggering the agent, and independent verification of this automation flow working in practice.
